# telnyx_wireless_blocklists (Data Source)

Lists wireless blocklists, with optional filters. Each item has the attributes of `telnyx_wireless_blocklist`.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `filter_name` (String)
- `filter_type` (String)
- `max_items` (Number) Stop reading after this many items. By default every page is read.

### Read-Only

- `wireless_blocklists` (Attributes List) The objects, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--wireless_blocklists))

<a id="nestedatt--wireless_blocklists"></a>
### Nested Schema for `wireless_blocklists`

Read-Only:

- `created_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was created.
- `id` (String) Identifies the resource.
- `name` (String) The wireless blocklist name.
- `type` (String) The type of the wireless blocklist.
- `updated_at` (String) ISO 8601 formatted date-time indicating when the resource was updated.
- `values` (Set of String) Values to block. The values here depend on the `type` of Wireless Blocklist.
